name: smwmusic-touhou-fuujinroku-mountain-of-faith-roulette-of-misery-dark-side-of-fate-remix
title: Touhou Fuujinroku ~ Mountain of Faith - Roulette of Misery ~ Dark Side of Fate (Remix)
description:
𝐈 𝐭𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐦𝐢𝐬𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐭𝐮𝐧𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐩𝐚𝐬𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐠𝐨𝐝𝐬.

Did a remix of Dark Side of Fate from Touhou 10: Mountain of Faith. Simple yet memorable Touhou boss theme for sure. Just felt like doing another song from Mountain of Faith 'cuz the soundtrack's good. Nothing else I need to say here.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" is disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. A# Minor (Remix Pitch, turned on default)
2. C# Minor (Original Pitch)
3. B Minor (Custom Pitch)
